_source: IPL 2008-2024 ball-by-ball, 295,732 deliveries (github.com/ritesh-ojha/IPL-DATASET, MIT; data originally from Cricsheet, cricsheet.org, ODC-By 1.0). Computed by scripts/datasets/ipl_rates.py. Percentages are of balls faced (wides excluded); wide/no-ball rates are of all deliveries; wickets exclude run outs.
